title: Delegation, Roles, Authority, Communication & Succession
objective: Deliver one bounded read-only projection for explicit visible organizational roles, delegations, communication routes and succession plans, including explicit owner-backed organizational-authority scope references, while keeping canonical Organization/Faction/Relationship/Reputation, Character, Project/time/context and Permission/visibility owners authoritative and preventing descriptive hierarchy from becoming system permission or autonomous command authority.

governed_contract.record_rule: ODL-04 accepts only explicit owner-referenced records carrying organization/subject references, record kind, owner authority/reference, profile/context, provenance and visibility references. Role and delegation records may carry explicit organizational-authority-scope references; communication records may carry explicit endpoint/channel references; succession records may carry explicit predecessor-role, successor-subject and owner-provided sequence references. ODL-04 does not synthesize any record from title, rank, hierarchy, loyalty/cohesion, ODL-02 pressure, ODL-03 politics, member count, money, location or elapsed time.
governed_contract.resolution_rule: After visibility filtering, a record kind resolves only when visible compatible observed records agree on one semantic tuple under one profile/context tuple. Missing or explicit-unknown remains unknown; incompatible-only remains incompatible; divergent semantic tuples, profiles, contexts or mixed observed/incompatible evidence remains conflict. ODL-04 never auto-resolves canonical-owner contradictions.
governed_contract.authority_scope_rule: Organizational-authority-scope references are descriptive owner-backed references only. They never grant system permission, executable action authority, canonical ownership, autonomous command authority or permission bypass.
governed_contract.delegation_rule: Delegation is read-only owner-backed evidence. ODL-04 does not assign roles, create or revoke delegations, execute delegated actions, mutate relationships/reputation, or infer authority from organizational labels.
governed_contract.communication_rule: Communication routes/channels are read-only explicit owner evidence. ODL-04 does not send messages, create channels, mutate relationships, expose hidden endpoints, or infer reachability from hierarchy.
governed_contract.succession_rule: Succession plans are read-only explicit owner evidence. ODL-04 does not replace leadership, trigger succession, advance campaign time, create crisis/coup/split outcomes, or mutate organization/faction membership.
governed_contract.visibility_rule: Unauthorized roles, delegations, hierarchy/authority scopes, communication endpoints/routes, succession plans, relationship/reputation references, profile/context and provenance evidence are filtered before states, counts, summaries, search, provenance collections, deterministic receipts or AI context. Hidden cardinality is not disclosed.
governed_contract.persistence: No durable ODL-04 persistence, duplicate organization/relationship/permission/succession ledger or migration 0022.
governed_contract.ui: One accessible read-only panel with nonvisual record-state, owner/provenance, profile/context, authority-scope, delegation, communication, succession, unknown/conflict/incompatible and authority-boundary explanations.
governed_contract.validation: Exactly one ODL-04 current-family profile; genuine RED before production; final exact-head self-hosted Linux and Windows plus deterministic comparator; zero historical predecessor fanout.

preserved_boundaries: ODL-01..03 remain completed_verified and are not reopened.
Canonical Organization/Faction/Relationship/Reputation, Character, Project/time/context and Permission/visibility owners remain authoritative.

No role assignment, delegation mutation, relationship/reputation mutation, communication send/channel mutation, leadership replacement, succession event, faction membership mutation, owner mutation, command authority, system permission, campaign-time advancement, duplicate ledger, durable persistence or migration 0022 is introduced.
ODL-05+, SCL-01+, provider activation, tester distribution, release and deployment remain unauthorized.

retry_basis.evidence: Owner Continue requested ODL-04 execution after completed_verified ODL-03 closeout. Governed start resolves one bounded read-only four-record projection contract over explicit visible canonical-owner evidence.
changed_since_previous: ODL-03 is completed_verified and its implementation authority is retired.
ODL-04 moved from selection-only to one explicit bounded governed contract without product mutation.
